newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai technology exports up y-on-y 28pct in H1.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai technology exports up y-on-y 28pct in H1.

text.p: Shanghai technology exports hit $320 million in the first half of 1997, up a year-on-year 28 percent, the Business News said on Wednesday.
High-technology exports surged 30 percent in first-half 1997 compared with the same 1996 period, the newspaper said.
Shanghai exported more than 300 different high-tech commodities in the first half of 1997, an increase of 40 items compared with the year-ago period, it said.
Shanghai's 6,800 collective firms had achieved 30 percent growth in technology exports in the first half of 1997 compared with the same year-ago period, it said.
Technology export turnover for the collective companies was 20 billion yuan ($2.41 billion) for all of 1996, it said, without giving further detail.
